summaryZh: Wilkinson 实验室研究基因调控回路在正常发育与疾病中的作用，重点关注转录及转录后通路如何影响发育以及如何在疾病中失调。成员项目涉及microRNA/NMD调节的疗法研发与患者来源细胞模型的临床前研究。
researchQuestions: 转录与转录后调控通路如何影响正常发育，又如何在疾病中受到破坏？
methods: 成员Jenna Cecil项目：调节microRNA与NMD途径的囊性纤维化疗法研发
成员Beate Illek研究：使用患者来源细胞模型开展临床前研究

evidence.quote: Research Interest Our studies are centered on the impact of gene regulatory circuits in normal development and disease. Our laboratory is interested in how transcriptional and post-transcriptional pathways impact normal development and how they are disrupted in disease. Our research interests overlap with the following fields: RNA Stem cell biology Epigenetics Reproductive biology Developmental biology Neurobiology Cancer More About our Research Lab News View All News August 13, 2025 A Genetic Twist that Sets Humans Apart August 19, 2025 Scientists Examine Genetic Origins of the Human Brain September 5, 2025 UCSD research finds 'volume control' that genetically separates humans from chimps
Wilkinson Lab – The Wilkinson Lab studies are centered on the impact of gene regulatory circuits in normal development and disease.
Our laboratory is interested in how transcriptional and post-transcriptional pathways impact normal development and how they are disrupted in disease.

Jenna Cecil Undergraduate Student Jenna is a 3rd-year UCSD undergraduate student from Sacramento, California who is majoring in Bioengineering and Biotechnology. She is working on a novel therapy—involving modulation of microRNAs and the RNA turnover pathway NMD—to treat the devastating disease cystic fibrosis.

evidence.quote: Beate Illek, Ph.D. Electrophysiologist Beate is an electrophysiologist specializing in the study of cystic fibrosis, a genetic disease affecting ion transport in epithelial cells. Her research focuses on preclinical studies utilizing patient-derived cell models to evaluate and develop innovative therapeutic approaches targeting defective CFTR channel function.
